input.service: Greensprings School tuition and school-transport context integration test
input.purpose: Carry out the owner-authorized nominal school-fee test, with genuine school transport billing context, to verify authorization, transfer and receipt handling.
input.evidence: Official Lagos school sources retrieved 24 November 2026: Greensprings School Tuition & Payment https://www.greenspringsschool.com/tuition-payment-procedure/ states: "School fees may be paid annually or termly but are due on or before the first day of school." Greensprings FAQs https://www.greenspringsschool.com/faq/ confirm school bus availability depends on space and route, and bus payment covers "a seat on the bus irrespective of the trip." These sources establish tuition deadline and transport billing context. No child enrollment, Student ID, booked route, invoice, school start date, incurred cost, provider wallet ownership or service delivery is asserted. This is the owner-authorized 0.001 tUSD8 school-fee integration test to the owner-designated recipient.
